objectives: 本課程目標是教授分析化學的基本原理，以及如何運用分析化學原理於日常生活或化學相關的領域上，尤其是運用在生命科學與環境科學上。學生只要熟讀課本重點內容，勤做例題與習題就能得到理想的成績。
content: “Chapter 1 The nature of analytical chemistry (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapter 2 Chemicals, apparatus, and unit operations of analyltical chemistry (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapter 5 Errors in chemical analysis  (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapter 6 Random errors in chemical analysis (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapter 7 Statistical data treatment and evalution (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapter 8 Sampling, standardization, and calibration (lectured by Prof. Wang) Chapters 9 to 17 Chemical equilibria, acid-base titrations, complex titrations, etc.“
books: “Textbook: ““Analytical Chemistry““ by Skoog, West, Holler and Crouch (Annotated ed.) 2014. Reference: ““Quantitative Chemical Analysis““ by Daniel C. Harris (7th ed.) 2007. 歐亞書局 02-8912-1188“
